title: Charter: the filing door — a card exists only for four classes, every seat paces its writes, and the grading contract closes the gaps it measured (successor of the lost #19494 / #19546)
body:
Path: none | tooling | maintainer-directed — dispatched at filing, never queued

Filed by the director seat, summon #25 (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`). Three maintainer sentences govern it, verbatim (chat, 2026-09-21): 「19546 帮我派发处理」; 「刚才 os-sam 又被封号了，也是因为分诊批量处理issue的时候，所以现在 issue 太多对于车队是负担。 19546 我希望在创建issue 的环节就卡死，没必要的issue就不要创建。」; 「19546 卡片好像也丢了，要重新写。你创建一个新的吧，而且注意不要和之前的一模一样」. The two earlier cards on this subject (#19494, then its rebuild #19546) disappeared with the accounts that filed them; this card is written fresh from the seat's own notes, shorter, and carries the maintainer's new direction first. ⛔ It restates nothing from the rulings already on `main` (ruling #202 B via #19457; the feature axis via #19483; ruling #208 via #19496 / #19497 / #19498).

## What the board looks like today

| reading (2026-09-21T08:45Z, REST) | value |
|:--|--:|
| issues created in the last 24 h, objectstack + objectui | 183 (116 + 67) |
| of those, already closed the same day | 64 |
| of those, titled `[finding]` | 41 |
| seat accounts suspended by GitHub during bulk issue operations today | 2 (their cards vanished with them) |

The cost is no longer the dev queue — it is the board itself: every open card is scanned by every seat every fire, every write is a strike against an account's standing, and a third of what gets filed is closed within the day.

## Part A — the filing door (the maintainer's direction; lands first)

1. **Four classes, or no card.** An issue is created only for (a) a product defect with a named landing spot or a reproduction; (b) a decision only the maintainer can make (`needs-user-decision`, 速读 + 四棱 on filing); (c) a task the maintainer directed, quoting the sentence; (d) a coordination node that rule 2 requires (a cross-repo or cross-layer parent and its per-layer sub-issues). The body's first line names the letter.
2. **Named non-cards.** An instrument's misfire or a gate's false reading (ruling #208 R2: no dev — now also no card); a seat's own mistake, protocol observation or lesson (seat post or closing brief); a `finding` outside the three classes (formerly 「首触即关」, now never filed); a rebuild of a lost card unless it is (a)–(d) on its own merits; any pointer, notice or request a comment on an existing card can carry; a pin, bump or hygiene reminder a sweep re-derives each fire.
3. **Three answers before POST.** The filer writes the class letter, the reader who acts on it (which seat, which step) and the dedupe query it ran with the hit count. A card missing any of the three is closed at first touch by triage, ungraded, with one line naming what is missing.
4. **Quota.** A seat files at most three new issues per fire; a sweep that finds more folds the rest into one card carrying the list, or into the seat post. Stock cleanup stays in maintainer-confirmed groups of ten (#19458's shape).
5. **Paced writes.** Every seat spaces its REST writes (issues, comments, labels, closes) by at least three seconds and keeps under forty writes per hour per account; a 429 or a secondary-rate-limit response stops that seat's writes for the rest of the fire, logged on the seat post; no script loops closes without a confirmed group and a pause between writes.

## Part B — the grading contract's measured gaps (the seat's notes, each with the card it happened on)

- The tightened keep criterion (「接进 CI 且实测害过一次派发/落地,或护客户可见契约」) is blind to **false green** — #16770: two gates read two documents, no join, both green while the declarations disagree. Add: a green line a serious reader takes as 「checked」 that checked nothing counts one human catch as one measured cost.
- 「仪器为车队服务」 lists **four** acceptable answers, not two — #19129: a false red's standard cost is a seat complying with it; one named seat action on one named card counts as much as a mis-dispatch or a failed landing.
- Chain inheritance (North Star item 3) is an **upper bound**; the card's own failure shape decides the grade within it — #19189: a re-queueable PR is a tax, not a wall (「墙齐平,税降一格」).
- The checklist test has **three states**, not two — objectui#10190: (1) the item would fail ⇒ inherit its priority; (2) the item asserts the capability but its steps cannot reach the path ⇒ add a step AND inherit the priority, ⛔ not p3; (3) no item asserts it ⇒ gap, author it, p3. State (2) is the common one now that `area:*` inherits from the item.
- North Star item 4 (「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句,等于产品缺陷」) applies to **shipped** faces (`skills/**`, product docs), ⛔ not `.claude/**`; it counts a **wrong** sentence, ⛔ not a missing one — #19239 (closed), objectui#10195 (p3), #16767 (kept).
- Sending a card to the decision box re-reads its premise in the same act — #19030 (a defect fixed three days earlier was ruled on).
- `pm:retriage` is judged by **content** (a comment stating the ask), ⛔ not by shape — #18374 (a ruling comment self-declared as the request; ~10 h lost).
- A zero that claims absence carries a control, and the control proves reach ⛔ not that the probe is right; exact-name matching, ⛔ prefix — #18104 (five prefix hits were another script; the exact name had zero and was running).
- The reach radius has two arms — maintainer 「今天谁在疼 你判断不了,我们是一个开发工具,你扫描不到第三方开发者会用它开发什么」: inside this repo's CI / seat actions / run records a zero is a zero; on faces shipped to third-party developers (`packages/*/dist`, `.d.ts`, `content/docs/**`, `skills/**`, tombstone prescriptions, refusal messages, CHANGELOG, protocol accept/reject) 「点不出受害者」 is not evidence — the test is 「它对不对」, wrong ⇒ keep. On `packages/spec`, 「辅助面」 does not imply 「可关」; a card's landing spot inside the radius does not imply what it protects is inside.
- A git-ignored directory is a convention, ⛔ not an empty set — #19217 (closed as 「never run」 while `runs/README.md` says results live in `qa-run` issues: 26 of them). A zero is a reading only with reach, a probe on a key the contract has, and a population that is where the phenomenon appears.
- One board enumeration per fire; statistics from the `board-archive` snapshot offline; patrol daily, not per fire.

## Landing

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (〈立卡门〉 beside the filing rules of 〈分诊座位职责〉; the grading lines), `references/core-rules.md` (twins only), `references/platform-readings.md` (the reading criteria extend 「零命中须配同主体必中词」). Tier H, the maintainer merges by hand. Ratchet paid in place — the former `finding` first-touch lines merge into the door; ⛔ no ceiling raise, ⛔ no rule deleted to pay.

**Not in this card, each needs the maintainer's own word (ruling #208 R6):** a mechanical throttle inside `post-stamped.mjs` / `label-write.mjs`; a refusal in `label-write.mjs` when `domain:*` / `priority:*` is written without a pm-state label; a `filed.log` for filed cards; the backup status written into the board snapshot.

Class: (c). Reader: the `domain:skills` lane, via the director's dispatched dev. Dedupe: titles over 445 open objectstack cards for `立卡|filing|grading|定级|判据` → #19457 (landed), #19483 (landed), #19127 (landed via #19506); none carries the door.
